My name is Francisco Ramírez, but everybody calls me Paco.

I graduated as a Mechanical Engineer from ITESM in Mexico, which was followed by a Masters from UCL in the UK. Recently, I graduated from a Master's in Data Science at The University of British Columbia in Vancouver, BC. 

I have a background in Mechanical Engineering and over 12 years of experience in the aerospace industry focusing on aircraft and gas turbine engine performance, most recently in technical leadership and management roles.

I am looking forward to joining the Data Science community in Vancouver, BC!

You can send me an email through the form below, or at [fraramfra@gmail.com](mailto:fraramfra@gmail.com), or feel free to contact me through [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/fraramfra/).
